Nothing mints a client-scoped session from a grant, and nothing records an open of the books by name (access_events records access CHANGES only). Planned: POST /api/practice/clients/:id/open + practice_open rows (CA2). |
| 6 | ask | Accounts | a practice person asks ON THE CHIT: a commenter the client's team (internal thread), an editor also the client's supplier (external thread); each answers in its own login | `web:public/app/rail-thread.js` `mount()`<br>`web:public/app/rail-thread.js` `send()`<br>`web:public/app/cap-messages.js` | `api:lib/access.js` `canMessage()`<br>`engines:src/rail.js` `byLevel()` | `POST /api/chits/:chit_id/messages` `api:routes/chits.js`<br>`GET /api/chits/:chit_id/messages` `api:routes/chits.js` | a message on the client's chit (msg_type query, exists), internal or external thread | none | `web:e2e/rail-thread-guard.cjs`<br>`api:tests/iam-access.test.cjs`<br>`engines:tests/rail.test.js` | ⚠️ — The ONE composer (CBThread), the ladder (a commenter posts internally, an editor externally, a viewer reads and sees the sentence) and msg_type 'query' (migrations/000_baseline_part2.sql CHECK) exist and are reused as they are. No due date and no answered flag: the thread's last message says whose turn it is (REQUIREMENT §9).
